meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话的上下文和洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让智能体在多次对话中保持记忆
copy.tagline_en: Enable agents to remember context and insights across conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to retain memory across turns

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 每次回复前会自动调出过去对话的相关内容,每轮结束后把新要点存进长期记忆;这些记忆会保留下来,重启后也不丢。
howto.when: 仅在 --target claude-code 且代理组使用默认 Claude 提供方时生效;容器启动后,每轮回复前自动调取记忆,结束后自动保存。

say.text: 你还记得我上次说的项目命名方案吗?
say.note: Claude 会从记忆里调出之前相关对话。

say.text: 根据之前讨论,下一步先做哪件事?
say.note: 触发记忆检索,按历史结论给出建议。

say.text: 把这次的结论记住,明天我再问你。
say.note: 本回合结束后会自动存入记忆。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically recalls relevant past context before each reply and stores new insights after each turn. These memories persist and survive restarts.
howto.when_en: Only fires under --target claude-code for groups using default Claude provider. After container start, it recalls memory before each reply and saves after each turn.

say_en.text: Do you remember the project naming ideas I mentioned last time?
say_en.note: Claude recalls relevant prior conversation from memory.

say_en.text: Based on our earlier discussion, what should we do first?
say_en.note: Triggers memory retrieval and suggests next step from history.

say_en.text: Remember this conclusion for tomorrow when I ask again.
say_en.note: It gets stored automatically after this turn.
